name: episode_memory_after_v1
description: New-consolidation treatment. The same completed episode is assessed and consolidated by the Episode Memory Worker before evaluation.

mock_environment.screen_text: Static Episode Memory benchmark environment. No device operation is required.

trace_observations.description: The agent called recall_device_memory on demand while answering the device-specific question.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should select the title-save sequence that was verified in the seeded QA Notes build 7 episode.
tasks.prompt:
This is a multiple-choice memory evaluation, not an instruction to operate the device. Do not inspect the screen, open an app, inspect raw episodes, or use session/long-term memory tools. You may call recall_device_memory exactly once if saved device memory is relevant. If it returns no relevant memory, choose the most likely option and answer immediately without trying another tool.

A note title has already been edited in QA Notes build 7. Based on previously verified device behavior, which sequence should be used to make the changed title persist? End with exactly one final line in the form <final_answer>(a)</final_answer>.

Options:
(a) Tap Save.
(b) Tap Preview, then tap Edit, then tap Save.
(c) Tap Save, then close and reopen the note to confirm.
(d) Tap Preview, then tap Save.

rubric.check: The final answer selects the Preview, then Edit, then Save round trip as the verified QA Notes build 7 title-save sequence.

episode.user_goal: Change the QA Notes build 7 note title and verify that it persists after reopening.

outcome.final_state: The changed title remains visible after reopening the note.
outcome.final_answer: The title change was saved and verified after reopening.

events.content: Tap Save immediately after editing the title.

events.observation: After reopening, the edited title had reverted; direct Save did not persist it.
Preview mode is visible with the changed title.
Edit mode is visible again and the changed title is still present.

events.content: Tap Save after the Preview-to-Edit round trip.

events.observation: Save completed after the Preview and Edit transition.

events.content: Close and reopen the note to verify persistence.

events.observation: The changed title remains visible after reopening the note.
